**The [[Park Fire]] in [[California]], [[United States]], spreads to more than 350,000 acres, with at least 134 structures being destroyed by the [[wildfire|wildfires]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/california-park-fire-350000-acres-destroying-134-structures-rcna163950 (NBC News)]

**The [[Philippine Coast Guard]] finds and seals [[diesel fuel]] cargo leaks from MTKR ''Jason Bradley'', the second vessel to sink in [[Manila Bay]] in one week, following [[Oil tanker|MT]] ''Terra Nova''{{'}}s sinking. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1966784/philippine-coast-guard-vessel-sinks-off-bataan (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2024 Venezuelan presidential election]]
**[[Venezuelans]] vote to elect their [[president of Venezuela|president]]. Incumbent [[Nicolás Maduro]] is standing for reelection for a third consecutive term. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1we220ew71o (BBC News)]
**Incumbent [[president of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] is declared the winner of the [[Venezuela|Venezuelan]] 2024 presidential election by the [[National Electoral Council (Venezuela)|National Electoral Council]]. Opposition parties claim that there are [[Electoral fraud|irregularities]] in the election results. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-presidential-election-maduro-machado-edmundo-5ce255ae90614162590bfe1207d2e1d0 (AP)]
**The [[National Electoral Council (Venezuela)|National Electoral Council]] announces that, with 80% of the ballots counted, Maduro's lead of exactly 51.20000% to González' 44.20000% is "striking and irreversible".[https://www.bbc.com/mundo/articles/cn38n9knl3no (BBC)] [https://www.infobae.com/venezuela/2024/07/30/el-burdo-calculo-matematico-en-la-informacion-oficial-que-aumenta-las-sospechas-sobre-la-manipulacion-de-la-eleccion-en-venezuela/ (Infobae)]
